executions.name: Decanted
executions.script: He doesn't touch them. One raised hand, a sommelier's twist — their blood answers him through the pores, lifting in a thousand fine threads that braid into a sphere above his palm. The husk drops like laundry. He tastes the vintage, considers, and — highest praise — finishes the glass.

executions.name: The Red Cellar
executions.script: A blur; the loser is inverted, ankle-chained to a rafter that wasn't there before, above a single crystal glass. He opens the throat with one thumbnail, sits in a chair that also wasn't there before, and waits for the glass to fill. The camera holds on the drip. He has time.

desecration.name: Corkage
desecration.script: The decorous two-fang tap simply continues past the bell — the freeze-frame is his hand raised politely: a moment, please.

overdrive.name: THE RED HARVEST
overdrive.script: He unhinges entirely — greatcoat blooming into a wall of wings — and hits the opponent as a swarm from six angles, each pass a long red thread pulled from them to him, reassembling on the far side flushed, young, and bored.
